procedure: stable-candidate validation and review of T002 to T007 (all REQ / SC)
candidateBinding: Code candidate commit 6045c1f2e5325250bf131e04e3caa06180ddaa98 on branch har/067-t011 (base origin/develop 425e3064). The evidence commit that adds this file and the assurance.json entries changes no code.

applied: receipts: a claimed depth above the effective one now requires that depth's reviews (reviews derived from the receipt depth and the artifact risk, not the re-sealable review section)

receipts: artifact must have exactly the compiled key set; its review section must equal the ladder for its own depth and docsOnly, and docsOnly must equal the risk docsOnly (a re-sealed artifact with emptied reviews is refused)
receipts: RecursionError and OverflowError map to the fixed reason invalid-artifact

rejected.finding: exit code 1 accepted in a receipt
rejected.reason: contract records commands with exit codes as process evidence, not as a pass criterion; documented in the verify_receipt docstring and pinned by a test

rejected.finding: merge: autonomous is a valid profile
rejected.reason: Q2 admits standing authorization only at merge; autonomous merge is operator-owned and floors stay human-only

rejected.finding: case-sensitive SHARED_FILES, reviewer ids not case-folded, free text allows @mention
rejected.reason: low severity, fail-safe or cosmetic; recorded for a later task

recorded: standing-authorization record is bound by id only (profile lists ids); binding the record digest in the profile needs a profile schema change (own 067 task)
docs-only default depth R1 (Q1) needs a per-preset docs depth in the profile schema (F6; own 067 task)
classify_risk trusts the caller-supplied impact seam and compile_artifact does not recompute docsOnly from the diff (test_residual_a pins this); recomputation belongs to the verifying side

reviews.result: closed catalog, raise-only risk and advisory-only compile fail safe; standing expiry depends on the caller-supplied now; floors are human-only only as far as the caller's actor kind is honest (binding, not authenticity)

applied: tests added for hidden size and shared-file reasons, scripts/** bare directory, path-count bound, standing-mode approval mismatch, claimed-depth reviews, nested artifact

rejected.reason: impact is a deliberate test seam and verification must recompute from the diff; see recorded residual

reviews.result: no must-fix beyond the receipts changes; duplication of the unsealed-digest helper and REASONS tuples recorded as optional cleanup

prProfileEvidence: The three failures above keep the local pr profile red for reasons unrelated to SPEC-067. The CI validate aggregate on the PR head is the pr-profile evidence of record; this file does not claim a green pr run.
authoritySnapshotFreezeHumanReview: Not done here: the authority snapshot commit, stage change and human_review are founder-owned and stay pending.
limits: Structural and unit evidence plus model reviews; reviews are not independent human review and prove no soundness. No utility claim for assurance profiles (H1 is registered-not-run).
taskEvidenceNote: Pointers only: those files record their own input hashes, which are historical (later tasks changed shared modules); they are not re-validated against the current tree here.
